name: readable-test-cases
goal: Recorded test cases stay readable at desktop tablet and mobile sizes, with exact input and output available on demand

evidence: Shared test-case spec: names lead roomy input/output panels; narrow panes stack; compact JSON preserves values and full recordings remain available.
Before repair, all three new desktop/tablet/mobile case-flow regressions failed: case headings sat beside values. Generated formatter stub failed 11 focused tests.
Reuse EntityCases in both viewers. Add compactRecordedValue through the util generator; retain parser, errors, gaps, and revision semantics.
Same three case-flow regressions passed. All ten report browser cases and nineteen focused formatter/component unit tests passed; shared impact checks passed 13 tests.
